description: $0.01 per call whatever the answers. Use to grade a list of your own rug or graduation calls: the outcome labels of 1 to 40 distinct pump.fun mints in the order asked, with the fields and the fixed public rule of mint_outcome; for one mint mint_outcome ($0.001) costs less. No probabilities, no opinions.
